findings.title: Keep absent ready facts explicit in the failed-partial report
findings.trigger: The unchanged launcher accepts any message with event qualification.ready and bounded JSON size. A returned ready message missing scope/profile/history/authorityMode/claimEligible/payloadIdentity/runtimeConfigurationIdentity/listenUrl then fails installedTransactionBinding at673.
findings.observedSourceBehavior: The finally report constructs ready with direct property reads from Record<string,unknown>. Missing values are undefined; JSON serialization omits those members. A failed-partial report therefore lacks the fixed readyKeys declared in report-contracts.json, rather than recording unavailable facts as null.
findings.impact: A strict future auditor cannot consume this failure using the declared closed report shape; unavailable versus omitted evidence is not represented as promised. The callback still fails and gives no positive credit; this is a report precision issue, not a stale-success or production route defect.
